Condition & remarks: New starter motor New battery All technical functions have not been tested. The machine warns of high coolant temperature. No troubleshooting has been performed. Engine & drive: Fuel: Diesel Drive: Hydrostatic Engine power: 365 kW / 496 hp Engine: AGCO Power, 9.8 liters, 7-cylinder Operating hours: Engine hours: 1,254.4 h Threshing hours: 933.1 h Threshed area according to display: 229.4 ha Capacity & specification: Header: 30 feet / approx. 9.2 m working width Grain tank: 12,500 liters Machine weight according to nameplate: 17,400 kg Permissible total weight according to nameplate: 20,000 kg Permissible front axle load: 11,500 kg Permissible rear axle load: 9,500 kg Fendt specifies for the 9490 X, among other things, a 12,500 liter grain tank and PowerFlow header. Equipment: Fire extinguisher equipment Warning sound Header & transport trailer: Header included. Transport cart for cutting table included. Wear, scuffs and scratches occur. See pictures for further information and condition assessment.
